network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Database mode and multi-terminal server configuration.
network.mode_explainer: "Mode" switches where this PC's database lives (a local file, or a shared network server). "LAN Sync" is a different, simpler way to keep separate registers in sync over a direct cable — use one or the other, not both.
network.tooltip_db_mode: Standalone keeps a local database file on this PC. Network connects to a shared database server used by every register.
network.mode_change_warning: Changing database mode requires application restart.
network.tooltip_host: The IP address of the PC running the shared database server.
network.tooltip_port: The network port the database server is listening on. Leave the default unless it was changed on the server.
network.tooltip_dbname: The name of the database on the server to connect to.
network.tooltip_user: The database login username configured on the server.
network.tooltip_password: The database login password configured on the server.
network.tooltip_test_connection: Checks that this PC can reach the database server with the settings above.
network.connection_success_message:
{message}

You can now upload your data.
network.validation_required_fields: Please fill in all required fields (Host, Database Name, Username).
network.migration_info:
Setting up the Main Server? Upload your current data to get started.

This will transfer all products, customers, and sales history to the network database.
The target database must be empty.
network.tooltip_migrate: Uploads this PC's current products, customers, and sales history to the network database. Only needed once, when first setting up the server.
network.migrating_progress:
Migrating data to server...
Please wait.
network.migration_success_message:
{message}

Next steps:
1. Save these network settings
2. Restart the application
3. All terminals can now connect to the server
network.migration_error_message:
An unexpected error occurred during migration.
Please check the application logs for details.
network.validation_before_migrate: Please fill in all required connection fields before migrating data.
network.sync_desc: Keep separate databases on each computer in sync automatically. Connect multiple registers over a LAN cable — one PC acts as the Main (hub), others connect as Terminals.
network.tooltip_terminal_mode: Standalone keeps this PC out of LAN Sync. Main PC hosts the sync server for other registers. Terminal connects to an existing Main PC.
network.tooltip_terminal_id: A short name for this register, shown in sync logs on the Main PC.
network.tooltip_sync_port: The network port this Main PC listens on for Terminal connections. Leave the default unless it conflicts with another program.
network.tooltip_main_pc_address: The Main PC's IP address and Sync Port, separated by a colon.
network.tooltip_sync_interval: How often this Terminal checks the Main PC for changes.
network.sync_secret_placeholder: Required — same value on every PC
network.tooltip_sync_secret: A password shared by every PC in the sync group. Must match exactly on the Main PC and all Terminals.
network.tooltip_test_sync: Checks that this Terminal can reach the Main PC with the address and Shared Secret above.
network.tooltip_forget_main: Only needed if you replaced the Main PC and this Terminal now refuses to sync with it.
network.sync_failed_secret_message:
Shared Secret does not match the Main PC's.

Enter the same Shared Secret configured on the Main PC, then try again.
network.sync_forget_main_confirm_message:
This Terminal will trust whichever Main PC answers at the configured address the next time it connects.

Only do this if you intentionally replaced the Main PC.
network.sync_forget_main_done_message: Done. This Terminal will re-pin on next connection.
